job.job_description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced GenAI Data Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, and Cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable AI/ML solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern MLOps practices. This role requires strong analytical thinking, hands-on Python development, and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready solutions.




Key Responsibilities:

Gather, analyze, and understand business requirements, translating them into scalable technical solutions.
Design and develop end-to-end Generative AI applications using LLMs, RAG architectures, and AI agents.
Build, deploy, and maintain production-grade Machine Learning pipelines and Python-based services.
Develop scalable data engineering solutions, including ETL pipelines and SQL-based data processing.
Collaborate with data engineering, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions.
Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, monitoring, and deployment automation.
Deploy and manage AI/ML workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Evaluate ML models using appropriate performance metrics and ensure responsible AI practices.
Optimize AI models and data pipelines for scalability, reliability, and performance.
Participate in solution design, code reviews, testing, and production support activities.



Required Skills:

8+ years of overall IT experience.
Strong experience in requirement elicitation, business analysis, and solution design.
Expertise in statistical analysis and analytical problem-solving.
Advanced proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience in production Machine Learning systems.
Strong experience with Generative AI technologies, including:
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI Agents
Solid experience in Data Engineering:
SQL
ETL development
Data processing pipelines
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Strong knowledge of MLOps practices, including:
CI/CD pipelines
Docker
Kubernetes
MLflow
Experience with model evaluation, monitoring, and Responsible AI principles.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
